Deploying a product into a customer's own cloud account, and writing the documents their security review consumes. PR-based infrastructure change and review culture — plan output read as evidence, not as a formality. SSO/OIDC, CloudFront behaviour and debugging. Nice to have AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer Professional). Azure or GCP exposure. WAF and edge security, EKS/Kubernetes, Datadog or Grafana-stack experience are signals of range, not requirements.
